question: How did the number of vessels in Skagen change from September 23 to 24 September 2026? Give both counts and the difference.
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-09-23' AND lon BETWEEN 10.55 AND 10.65 AND lat BETWEEN 57.70 AND 57.74), b AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-09-24' AND lon BETWEEN 10.55 AND 10.65 AND lat BETWEEN 57.70 AND 57.74)
SELECT a.n AS first_day, b.n AS second_day, b.n - a.n AS change FROM a, b
